UK Government Nationalises British Steel, Citing Supply Concerns

The UK government has taken control of British Steel, nationalising the company and bringing it back into public ownership for the first time since 1988. This move aims to protect a vital national supply capability and prevent the loss of jobs at the Scunthorpe plant. The decision follows a period of uncertainty over the company's future and has drawn a response from China, which has stated it will take measures regarding the nationalisation.
